concept.movement: Deliberate alternating steps with the visible thigh participating, stable toe pads and a restrained head nod; a lower, faster stepping run with folded-wing balance.
concept.attack: A short coil, forward/down beak jab and quick recoil, with a small wing flare and both feet supported.
concept.death: A forward breast-first slump, folded wings settling beside the body, released feet settling forward and outward, then held still.

concept.movement: Quick deliberate alternating steps with the visible thigh participating, stable toe pads and a restrained head nod; a brisk low stepping run with folded-wing balance.
concept.attack: A short coil, forward/down beak jab and quick recoil, with a small wing flare and both feet supported.
concept.death: A forward breast-first slump, folded wings settling beside the body, released feet settling forward and outward, then held still.

concept.movement: Hovering owl with tucked talons; broad deliberate wingbeats for slow travel, faster beats and a forward body pitch for fast flight. No planted-foot gait is claimed.
concept.attack: Short recoil into a forward beak-and-talon swoop; the legs reach forward and the toe branches open slightly, then recover to hover.
concept.death: Wings stop beating as the owl drops forward, opens its wings to settle, relaxes its talons and rests on the breast with a quiet tail.

concept.movement: Hovering owl with tucked talons; broad deliberate wingbeats for slow travel, faster beats and a forward body pitch for fast flight. No planted-foot gait is claimed.
concept.attack: Short recoil into a forward beak-and-talon swoop; the legs reach forward and the toe branches open slightly, then recover to hover.
concept.death: Wings stop beating as the owl drops forward, opens its wings to settle, relaxes its talons and rests on the breast with a quiet tail.

concept.movement: Hovering owl with tucked talons; broad deliberate wingbeats for slow travel, faster beats and a forward body pitch for fast flight. No planted-foot gait is claimed.
concept.attack: Short recoil into a forward beak-and-talon swoop; the legs reach forward and the toe branches open slightly, then recover to hover.
concept.death: Wings stop beating as the owl drops forward, opens its wings to settle, relaxes its talons and rests on the breast with a quiet tail.

concept.movement: A long-legged wading bird: deliberate alternating steps, visible knee and hock articulation, flat planted toes and folded wings. The faster gait lengthens and quickens the steps without turning into flight.
concept.attack: A short neck recoil into a long forward and downward beak stab, with both feet planted, then a quick recovery.
concept.death: A forward breast-first collapse. The long neck folds, the legs release behind the body and the feather skirt settles without a beak-supported hover.

concept.movement: A watchful marsh bird with slower high steps and half-open wings held for balance; a deliberate long beak thrust. Deliberate alternating steps, visible knee and hock articulation, stable toe contact and restrained wings. The faster gait lengthens and quickens the steps without turning into flight.
concept.attack: A short neck recoil into a long forward and downward beak stab, with both feet planted, then a quick recovery.
concept.death: A forward breast-first collapse. The long neck folds, the legs release behind the body and the feather skirt settles without a beak-supported hover.

concept.movement: A low stalking hunter, with separated stepping lanes, an alert swept crest and a quick downward beak strike. Deliberate alternating steps, visible knee and hock articulation, stable toe contact and restrained wings. The faster gait lengthens and quickens the steps without turning into flight.
concept.attack: A short neck recoil into a long forward and downward beak stab, with both feet planted, then a quick recovery.
concept.death: A forward breast-first collapse. The long neck folds, the legs release behind the body and the feather skirt settles without a beak-supported hover.

concept.movement: Bright, quick and upright, with crisp alternating steps and a short precise beak jab. Deliberate alternating steps, visible knee and hock articulation, stable toe contact and restrained wings. The faster gait lengthens and quickens the steps without turning into flight.
concept.attack: A short neck recoil into a long forward and downward beak stab, with both feet planted, then a quick recovery.
concept.death: A forward breast-first collapse. The long neck folds, the legs release behind the body and the feather skirt settles without a beak-supported hover.

concept.movement: A restrained side-to-side waddle with low webbed-foot recovery and a steady torso. A quicker, slightly lower run lengthens the alternating steps while the wings stay close.
concept.attack: A small neck recoil followed by a quick forward and downward bill jab, with a light wing flare and both webbed feet planted.
concept.death: The breast drops forward, the head and neck fold low, the feet release and the duck settles into a still supported pose.

concept.movement: A purposeful long-necked waddle, low alternating webbed-foot recovery and modest side-to-side weight transfer. The quicker run lengthens the step without bouncing the breast.
concept.attack: A sharp neck-driven bill thrust with a short recoil and an assertive wing flare, then a grounded recovery.
concept.death: The breast lowers forward; the long neck folds and the bill settles low while the webbed feet release outward and the body comes to rest.

concept.movement: A measured broad-bodied walk with quiet long-neck balance, low webbed-foot recovery and restrained sway. The run stays low and deliberate with folded wings.
concept.attack: A deliberate S-neck recoil followed by an extended forward bill jab and a small balanced wing flare.
concept.death: The breast settles first, the curved neck folds forward in a continuous arc, and the wings and released feet settle into a supported held pose.

concept.movement: A purposeful heavy-bodied strut with alternating clawed steps, a restrained neck bob and quiet tail-fan balance. The run lowers the body and lengthens the quick stepping cycle.
concept.attack: A brief head recoil followed by a decisive forward and downward peck, with a small folded-wing flare and both feet braced.
concept.death: The breast drops forward, the neck folds low and the feet release outward as the heavy body settles into a still supported pose.

concept.movement: An alert chest-up strut, quick alternating claws and restrained head counter-motion; a compact urgent ground run with the sickle feathers balanced behind.
concept.attack: A sharp head recoil into a fast forward/down peck, braced claws and a brief folded-wing flare.
concept.death: The breast folds forward, the comb and wattles follow the dropping head, and released claws settle beside the supported body.

concept.movement: A low, watchful stalking step with long alternating advances and quiet long-tail balance; a quick level-bodied escape run.
concept.attack: A compact neck coil and darting beak strike with minimal wing opening, returning quickly to an alert stance.
concept.death: The narrow breast slumps forward, the neck folds and the long tail remains attached as the legs release into a still grounded collapse.

concept.movement: A deliberate upright procession with low, measured claw steps and a quiet centered train; a shorter urgent ground run that keeps the train coherent.
concept.attack: A poised neck recoil into a decisive forward/down beak jab, modest wing opening and planted claws.
concept.death: The breast lowers forward, the slim neck folds down and the train settles behind the supported body while the toes release.

concept.movement: A deliberate alternating ground step with a small lateral weight shift, articulate gripping toes and a quiet long tail. The quick run takes longer low steps with a purposeful forward lean.
concept.attack: An alert head recoil into a forceful forward/down hooked-beak bite, with planted claws and a brief balanced wing flare.
concept.death: The breast drops forward, the beak and neck fold toward the ground and the released feet settle beside the body while the long tail follows its attachment.
concept.flight: Original native wingbeat and its source corrective shapes retained unchanged.

concept.movement: An upright, long-legged stride with alternating full forward steps, quiet body carriage and a restrained head counterbalance. The run takes longer, faster steps with higher foot recovery and a slight forward lean.
concept.attack: A quick braced forward kick: one leg chambers, extends its complete two-toed foot toward the target and recovers, while the other foot supports the body and the small wings balance the strike.
concept.death: The long legs fold and release as the breast settles forward onto the ground; the long neck folds low in front and the feet come to rest beside the supported body.

concept.movement: A compact upright waddle with clear alternating webbed-foot steps, a gentle side-to-side weight shift and steady head carriage. A quick scuttle uses a faster cadence, slightly longer steps and low toe recovery.
concept.attack: A short braced body lean and quick forward beak nip, with the flippers flaring for balance before returning to the quiet stance.
concept.death: The upright body tips forward onto its breast and belly, the head settles low, the flippers relax outward and the short legs release beside the body before the pose holds.

concept.movement: A deliberate webbed-foot walk with the heavy body steady and the long bill carried forward. The quicker run lengthens the alternating steps while the folded wings and bill stay coherent.
concept.attack: The neck coils briefly, then drives the complete long bill and pouch forward in a forceful downward jab while both webbed feet brace and the wings open slightly for balance.
concept.death: The breast settles forward, the long neck folds low and the bill rests ahead of the body. The webbed feet release beside the torso and the wings and tail settle into a still supported pose.
concept.flight: Original native flight and every original corrective shape are retained unchanged.

concept.movement: Low deliberate four-beat crawl with a rigid shell, outward elbows and complete clawed-foot contact. The faster scramble retains grounded support and low foot recovery.
concept.attack: Four planted feet brace a short recoil and forceful forward/downward head strike. No independent jaw motion is implied by this rig.
concept.death: The body settles forward onto the plastron, the neck droops, and the feet relax slightly outward before holding still.

concept.movement: A weighty four-beat crawl with short, purposeful clawed-foot steps and a solid crystal shell. The quicker scramble increases leg recovery while keeping the heavy torso steady.
concept.attack: Four feet brace a neck recoil, then a forceful forward and downward armored-head strike. The shell follows with a restrained forward drive before recovery.
concept.death: The heavy shell lowers onto its underside, the neck folds down, and the feet ease outward into a fully supported, still end pose.

concept.movement: A draconic armored four-beat crawl with a restrained, centered tail follow-through. Low deliberate four-beat crawl with a rigid shell, outward elbows and complete clawed-foot contact. The faster scramble retains grounded support and low foot recovery.
concept.attack: Four planted feet brace a short recoil and forceful forward/downward head strike. No independent jaw motion is implied by this rig.
concept.death: The body settles forward onto the plastron, the neck droops, and the feet relax slightly outward before holding still.

concept.movement: A low, deliberate four-beat crocodilian walk with wide planted palms, visible shoulder and thigh movement, a steady armored back and restrained trailing tail. The scramble lengthens and quickens the steps without bouncing.
concept.attack: Four feet brace a short coil and forceful straight-ahead head/body lunge, then recover. The source mouth keeps its natural gape; fused mouth tissue is not pulled apart to imply an independent jaw snap.
concept.death: The belly lowers forward to the ground, the head relaxes low, the limbs spread gently and the long centered tail settles behind the body before a still hold.

concept.movement: A low, deliberate four-beat basilisk stalk with wide planted palms, visible shoulder and thigh movement, a steady armored back and a raised spiked tail. The scramble lengthens and quickens the steps without bouncing.
concept.attack: Four feet brace a short coil and forceful straight-ahead head/body lunge, then recover. The source mouth keeps its natural gape; fused mouth tissue is not pulled apart to imply an independent jaw snap.
concept.death: The heavy belly lowers forward to the ground, the head relaxes low, the limbs spread gently and the centered spiked tail relaxes behind the body before a still hold.

concept.movement: A traveling lateral body wave moves the grounded belly and tapering tail while the raised hood watches forward. Faster slither increases the body wave and cadence without bouncing the head.
concept.attack: A short backward coil loads the neck, then the hood and head spear forward and down in one fast snake strike before recovering. The tongue and face remain coherent; the source gape is retained.
concept.death: The raised hood loses tension, the neck folds forward and the hood settles nearly flat on the ground; the supported body and tail relax into a still ending.

concept.movement: A grounded four-beat canine walk and diagonal trot, with full balanced strides, a quiet back and aligned mirrored paw lanes. Ashen Wolf keeps its lean stalking silhouette.
concept.attack: A clear backward load followed by a forward lunge, head-led bite, supported landing and recovery. Upper snout stays with the skull; only valid lower-jaw branches articulate.
concept.death: The head drops as the forelegs fold, the body rolls into supported flank/head contact, the paws release and relax, and the tail follows into a still grounded hold.

concept.movement: A grounded four-beat canine walk and diagonal trot, with full balanced strides, a quiet back and aligned mirrored paw lanes. Shadow Warg carries its bulky shoulders low and forward.
concept.attack: A clear backward load followed by a forward lunge, head-led bite, supported landing and recovery. Upper snout stays with the skull; only valid lower-jaw branches articulate.
concept.death: The head drops as the forelegs fold, the body rolls into supported flank/head contact, the paws release and relax, and the tail follows into a still grounded hold.

concept.movement: A grounded four-beat canine walk and diagonal trot, with full balanced strides, a quiet back and aligned mirrored paw lanes. Azure Hyena keeps its naturally taller shoulders and sloping back.
concept.attack: A clear backward load followed by a forward lunge, head-led bite, supported landing and recovery. Upper snout stays with the skull; only valid lower-jaw branches articulate.
concept.death: The head drops as the forelegs fold, the body rolls into supported flank/head contact, the paws release and relax, and the tail follows into a still grounded hold.

concept.movement: A steady, deliberate capybara amble on four short feet; the quicker gait is a compact diagonal scurry with a quiet broad back.
concept.attack: A defensive head-led nip and forward shoulder shove, with a restrained backward load, supported landing and recovery.
concept.death: The head and forequarters sink first, the short legs fold and release, and the broad chest and rump settle together into a still flank-supported pose.

concept.movement: A deliberate four-beat camel walk, with same-side legs following each other, and a faster lateral pace. Humps stay quiet while the long neck counterbalances the body.
concept.attack: An irritated, braced forward nip: the lower neck reaches forward, the head dips into the target and the body follows before recovering. The beard stays attached to the neck.
concept.death: The forequarters soften into a heavy supported flank collapse; the neck lowers with the body and the head, chest and rump settle together.

concept.movement: An alert, light four-beat walk and brisk diagonal trot. Long slender legs take complete alternating steps beneath a quiet, forward-facing torso; the neck counterbalances and the centered tail follows softly.
concept.attack: A clear upward horn load followed by an aggressive forward and downward horn-led thrust, with braced forehooves, a short body drive and controlled recovery.
concept.death: The forelegs fold first, then the narrow body settles onto its flank. The long horned head and chest/pelvis find real support, while released legs relax into a still hold.

concept.movement: A cautious, low four-beat amble with alternating full steps and a quiet back. The faster gait is a brisk compact diagonal scurry; the long centered plume follows with restrained lag.
concept.attack: A planted defensive warning: the head dips, shoulders brace, and the centered plume rises into an unmistakable arched warning before relaxing back to neutral.
concept.death: The forequarters lose support first, the short legs fold and release, and chest, rump and head settle together into a still supported flank. The plume follows the body without becoming a rigid prop.

concept.movement: A watchful, low mongoose amble with visible thigh motion and full alternating steps. Faster travel becomes a quick diagonal dart with small paw clearance, a quiet back and a trailing centered tail.
concept.attack: A sharp low dart and head-led nip: load briefly backward, drive the shoulders and muzzle forward over a quick forepaw step, brace, then recover the hind feet and forefeet in sequence.
concept.death: The alert head dips as the forelegs buckle, the short body yields into a supported flank, and the released limbs and low tail relax into a still grounded finish.

concept.movement: A deliberate four-beat armored amble with full short steps and a steady shell. Faster travel is a compact scurry driven by the legs beneath the shell, with little bounce or lateral roll.
concept.attack: Brace the hind feet, lower the snout and rake forward and down with the left foreclaw, followed by the right. The armored torso stays supported while each strong claw makes a clear reaching stroke and returns to its planted track.
concept.death: The snout lowers, the legs fold under the armored body and release into a supported flank. The shell retains its shape; head, rear body and narrow tail settle into a still grounded finish.

concept.movement: A cautious hunched amble with a low snout, complete alternating steps and visible rear-thigh motion. Faster travel becomes a short, brisk diagonal scurry; the narrow bare tail trails from a quiet rump.
concept.attack: A defensive low snap and shoulder dart from a brief withdrawn stance, with a compact forepaw step, braced landing and quick recovery. The closed native snout stays coherent with the skull.
concept.death: An abrupt loss of support becomes a deliberate faint: head and forequarters drop, the hips fold into a supported flank, the paws relax and the long tail settles low. Finish with a still play-dead pose.

concept.movement: A low, broad four-beat waddle with whole alternating steps and outward webbed palms. Quick travel becomes a brisk low scuttle, with a quiet back and a coherent paddle tail following the hips.
concept.attack: A brief backward brace leads to a low bill-first shove and compact forward forefoot step, followed by a planted recovery. The bill, eyes and face remain one coherent skull mass.
concept.death: The bill and chest lower as the webbed forefeet brace, then the animal releases its legs and settles onto a supported flank. The broad paddle stays whole, lowers with the pelvis and ends at rest.

concept.movement: A weighty, broad four-beat trundle with visible shoulder and thigh motion, quiet back and full planted claws. Faster travel becomes a low determined trot, with the short tail following the rump in one coherent shape.
concept.attack: A compact backward brace drives into a forceful shoulder and blunt-muzzle shove. Both forepaws reach and brace the landing before the body recovers its heavy stance.
concept.death: The muzzle lowers behind folding forelegs, then the bulky body settles onto a supported flank. Head, chest and pelvis carry the resting pose; the short tail relaxes with the rump without being forced to become a ground support.

concept.movement: A deliberate four-beat column-legged walk with long balanced steps, little bounce and a quiet heavy torso. Faster travel keeps staggered support and becomes a purposeful brisk walk; ears, trunk and tail follow with restrained secondary motion.
concept.attack: The elephant braces its broad feet, loads back, curls the trunk clear of the tusks and drives the head and shoulders forward into a forceful tusk-led shove. It lands heavily and recovers its broad stance.
concept.death: The trunk briefly curls clear as the forelegs yield and the knees fold. The broad body settles heavily onto a supported flank; ears fold at their bases, the trunk relaxes in a coherent curve and the tail settles beside the rump.

concept.movement: A broad, heavy four-beat trundle with full alternating steps, quiet barrel torso and visible upper-leg drive. Faster travel is a purposeful low trot with no flight; the short centered tail follows the rump coherently.
concept.attack: A brief backward brace loads the massive shoulders, then a forceful forward head-and-shoulder shove drives through a forefoot landing. The source closed muzzle stays coherent, with no unsupported jaw-opening deformation.
concept.death: The head lowers as the knees fold, then the heavy barrel settles onto a supported flank. Released paws relax with native section lengths while skull, chest and pelvis remain close to the ground in a still final hold.

concept.movement: A long balanced lateral four-beat walk, with visible upper-leg motion and a quiet back. Faster travel becomes a brisk grounded pace, with gentle neck following and a centered hanging tail.
concept.attack: A deliberate neck-and-head sweep loads to the right, then cuts fully across to the left from a braced stance. The body supports the neck arc before the head and forefeet recover together.
concept.death: The knees fold under the tall body before it rolls onto a supported flank. The long articulated neck and skull settle with the torso; released hooves relax into a still hold, and the tail follows the rump coherently.

concept.movement: A compact paired hind-foot hop at slow speed, opening into a faster bound. Both feet advance together in matching lanes, the haunches crouch and extend, the hands stay clear of the thighs, and a coherent centered tail balances the body.
concept.attack: A guarded backward load, one forceful forward hind-foot kick while the other foot stays braced, then a controlled recovery. The long tail counterbalances without claiming weight-bearing support.
concept.death: A brief forward gathering with the feet planted, followed by a forward chest-and-pelvis collapse. The neck settles with the skull, the released legs and hands relax and the tail follows into a supported still hold.

concept.movement: A deliberate four-beat knuckle-supported walk with long arms flared clear of the belly, changing to a quicker diagonal shoulder-led lope. Complete hands and broad feet maintain coherent support; the head stays forward and the shoulders move with restrained weight.
concept.attack: The right arm loads outward and rises into a broad overhand hammering swipe, sweeping forward and down below the face while the left knuckle and both feet remain braced. The spare arm follows the body and the striking hand stays coupled to the forearm.
concept.death: The limbs gather and brace as the body sags forward, then release into a chest-led collapse with the pelvis and skull settled together. Hands and feet relax with the limbs and the entire pose comes to a stable grounded hold.

concept.movement: A brisk four-beat palm-supported walk changes to agile diagonal travel. Hind knees fold forward and fore elbows fold back, broad palms and heels remain coherent, the forward muzzle and chest mane stay steady, and the centered tail flexes as one continuous shape.
concept.attack: The body gathers into a small forward lunge while the right forehand lifts outside the mane and rakes forward, downward and across the front. The left palm and both hind feet brace the motion; the complete hand turns with the forearm and returns to support. No independent jaw movement is invented.
concept.death: The head and forequarters sag with all four supports planted, then the limbs release and fold into a forward chest-led collapse. Pelvis, thorax and complete muzzle settle together, released palms and feet relax, and the centered tail follows the body into a stable grounded hold.

concept.movement: A low, heavy four-beat flipper shuffle becomes a quicker diagonal hustle. Broad front paddles step and brace while each multi-lobed rear flipper stays coherent; the belly, neck folds, tusks and whiskers retain their own shape.
concept.attack: All four flippers brace a short forward body-and-neck shove. The head loads back then drives the tusks forward and down before recovering; the source has no independent jaw control.
concept.death: The front support folds as the heavy trunk settles forward onto its belly and pelvis. The neck lowers into a tusk-supported rest, the paddles relax beside the body, and the complete pose holds without flipper or wrist spins.

concept.death: Supported forward collapse followed by a still hold.
